design.query: consecutive lines (>= 55 non-space chars, <= 6 lines) from each song's first seed-0 base line; clips under 5 s padded with trailing silence
design.blurred: perturb.py mixed at 40% of word units
design.single: condition S: the one base line, native voice, normal speed
design.korean_reading: LocalTTS jp2hangul: UniDic reading -> Hangul; per-song style (tsu, word-initial stops, long vowels, n before labials), pitch and rate varied

channels.phone_reverb_noise: synthetic RIR (RT60 0.2-0.6 s) + pink noise (SNR 10-20 dB) + 300-3400 Hz band, 8 kHz

design.stt: Whisper large-v3 (LocalTTS, transformers fp16 on GPU); language auto-detected (as app.py) or forced ja
design.search: app.py audio path: lyric-line top-1 song
design.typed_accuracy: same Japanese query text typed (no speech), for paired comparison
